title: Exact finite-sample geometry of the Jarque-Bera statistic: support, discriminants and elliptic integrals
summary: Under Gaussian sampling, removing location and scale turns the sample into a direction that is uniformly distributed on a sphere of dimension $n-2$, and sample skewness and kurtosis become a cubic-quartic polynomial image of spherical measure. We use this geometry to obtain exact finite-sample results for the Jarque-Bera statistic $\mathrm{JB}_n$.
